prompt.image: deep prussian blue blueprint on tracing paper, precise dimension lines, section marks, cream paper sheet, vermilion stamp, overhead inspection light, no text. Palette bg:#071b2b, surface:#0d2a3d, paper:#f4f1e8, accent:#4d8dff, warning:#ffb02e, stamp:#e5482f. Type NotoSansSC 700/900/Geist/Geist Mono. Motifs: blueprint grid, dimension line, section mark, tracing paper, rivet. Composition: leave deliberate negative space for a headline; no readable text, no logos, no letters.
prompt.video: 对比: 旧法 → 新法 → 证据 → 反例 → 落版. Motion: line draw, dimension close, section reveal, paper fold, stamp. Transition: 折纸/卷纸. Captions: 页边注. Sound: 纸张音. Hook pattern: 给 [对象] 装了这么多，你还记得几件？. Avoid the reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, transition combination, caption animation, motifs and SFX arrangement.
prompt.cover: 3:4 blueprint poster, oversized technical drawing, one red revision stamp, top blank for headline, cream and cobalt. Hook: 提问. Hero motif: blueprint grid. Brand block at bottom; keep key text in the top 75% and the right 120px clear. Render all text in HTML/SVG, not in the generated image.
